note: The Resources kit's adapter onto the material library (core/materials/PLAN.md): the ore nodes' rock is the same boulder set the Islanders kit draws its stone with, so a node reads the same in either kit. The veins, crusts and nuggets are vertex colours (no ore sets in the library). The ground is the Scyvoi kit's withered grass, a neutral backdrop. The sulfur crusts are the library's ground.sulphur, in full colour.
